chunks.title: Deepak Prasad: Senior Product Manager Profile & Positioning
chunks.chunk: Deepak Prasad is a Senior Product Manager with 7+ years of experience building and scaling products across SaaS, conversational AI, B2B marketplaces, consumer subscriptions, connected hardware, and workflow automation. He specializes in 0→1 discovery from ambiguous charters, turning physical and operational bottlenecks into scalable digital platforms across B2B and B2C ecosystems.

chunks.title: Education: Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) from VTU (2018)
chunks.chunk: Deepak Prasad holds a Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) from Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), graduating in 2018 with a technical foundation in systems engineering, signal processing, and computing.

chunks.title: Complete Career History & Chronological Timeline
chunks.chunk: Deepak's verified career chronology comprises five roles: 1) Associate Product Manager at LionCircuits (Jul 2018 – May 2020), 2) Product Manager at ReshaMandi (Jun 2021 – Sep 2023), 3) Product Manager at Sportstech (Aug 2023 – Sep 2024), 4) Senior Product Manager at Sportstech (Oct 2024 – May 2026), and 5) Product Consultant | Independent via Tejmonvi Softwares (May 2026 – Jul 2026). The verified resume lists no roles or activities for the gap between May 2020 and June 2021, and no details are inferred or assumed for that period.

chunks.title: Associate Product Manager at LionCircuits (Jul 2018 – May 2020)
chunks.chunk: Deepak's earliest listed professional role in his resume is Associate Product Manager at LionCircuits in Bengaluru (Jul 2018 – May 2020). LionCircuits is an IoT, AI, and PCB manufacturing platform. Deepak led the concept-to-launch of a B2B Assembly Ordering Platform that contributed to a 40% increase in monthly orders, built an auto-quote generation and BOM-scrubbing tool, and developed a Raspberry Pi-based AI proof-of-concept for traffic monitoring.

chunks.title: Product Manager at ReshaMandi (Jun 2021 – Sep 2023)
chunks.chunk: Deepak served as Product Manager at ReshaMandi (Jun 2021 – Sep 2023) in Bengaluru, owning core marketplace workflows and payments across ~1.1 Lakh stakeholders, including 80,000+ farmers via ReshaFarms. He digitized end-to-end operational workflows (LeadSquared CRM, Razorpay, SAP, Camunda), built an instant-payout workflow scaling monthly disbursements from ₹10–15 Cr to ₹20–25 Cr at 99.9% reliability, launched a real-time cocoon bidding auction 0→1 (>35% transaction uplift), and partnered with ML engineers to build a cocoon pricing model (>90% accuracy). Deepak's scope was strictly marketplace, field operations, and instant payouts; ReshaMudra credit products were not part of his ownership.

chunks.title: Product Manager at Sportstech (Aug 2023 – Sep 2024)
chunks.chunk: Deepak joined Sportstech in Bengaluru as the first Product Manager on the team (Aug 2023 – Sep 2024) and built the platform 0→1 from scratch. With no prior playbook, he designed user onboarding, signup, and end-to-end subscription monetization flows (pricing, packaging, trial mechanics, paywalls, and checkout), while establishing baseline conversion and retention metrics from first principles through direct customer interviews and PRDs.

chunks.title: Senior Product Manager at Sportstech (Oct 2024 – May 2026)
chunks.chunk: As Senior Product Manager at Sportstech (Oct 2024 – May 2026), Deepak owned subscription strategy for a B2C fitness platform serving 174,180 freemium users and 12,401 paying subscribers, generating €659K in FY2025 subscription revenue with 81.9% YoY subscriber growth and 96.8% annual retention. He led the 0→1 development of the in-app AI Coach (scaling ~300 to ~2,000 DAU in ~3 months, Gemini primary / ChatGPT fallback), built an AI video localization workflow (200+ videos in ~3 weeks, ~10× faster), and managed/mentored a 6-person cross-functional pod (3 PMs, Growth, Content) in an ODC model partnering with Germany HQ leadership.

chunks.title: Product Consultant | Independent via Tejmonvi Softwares (May 2026 – Jul 2026)
chunks.chunk: From May 2026 to Jul 2026, Deepak worked as an Independent Product Consultant via Tejmonvi Softwares in Bengaluru, advising early-stage ventures. He led product strategy for TNSQAI (a pre-commercial AI radiology diagnostics startup), benchmarking 7 global competitors and creating a Now/Next/Later roadmap based on ML evaluation metrics. He also advised early-stage founders on deal-flow digitization for an M&A marketplace and rights metadata management for a global music-rights platform.

chunks.title: Core Competencies, Tools & Technical Platforms
chunks.chunk: Deepak's competencies include Product Strategy (0→1 discovery, customer interviews, quarterly OKRs, roadmapping, PRDs, UAT, adoption tracking), B2B & B2C Monetization (SaaS, subscriptions, enterprise workflows, instant payouts), AI & Data (conversational AI, ML workflows with >90% accuracy, retention/churn modeling, telemetry), and Cross-functional Leadership (mentoring 6-person pods, ODC models). Tools: Jira, SAP (basic), Camunda, LeadSquared CRM, Razorpay, Figma, Firebase, Google Analytics, and Google Play Console.

chunks.title: ReshaMandi Thesis & Ground Field Research
chunks.chunk: The foundational thesis of ReshaMandi was: 'The product wasn't the app. The workflow was.' Field research in Ramanagara and Sidlaghatta mandis revealed an informal operational web running on 'Notebook → Photo → WhatsApp → Call'. Farmers arrived early with perishable crates in bright sunlight; requiring them to use a complex self-serve smartphone app failed. Deepak chose an assisted model: placing digital tools in the hands of trained collection centre staff while farmers received instant SMS confirmations.

chunks.title: ReshaMandi Instant Payout Engine & Settlement Rails
chunks.chunk: At ReshaMandi, Deepak owned the instant-payout workflow integrating Razorpay banking rails and internal accounting systems: transactions under ₹5L settled immediately upon lot weighing and quality confirmation, while amounts over ₹5L cleared within 2 hours. Payout reliability reached 99.9%, as monthly disbursement volume scaled from ₹10–15 Cr to ₹20–25 Cr across 80,000+ farmers, eliminating predatory middlemen credit cycles.

chunks.source: ReshaMandi Case Study: Cocoon Bidding & ML Pricing
chunks.title: Cocoon Bidding System & Computer Vision Pricing
chunks.chunk: Deepak built the real-time cocoon bidding workflow 0→1 (Scan → Bid → Watch → Win → Pay), replacing chaotic shouting auctions with structured bidding rules and lifting transaction value by >35% in pilot sessions. Alongside this, he partnered with ML engineers to build a computer vision pricing system analyzing cocoon samples for uniformity, discoloration, and shell ratio, providing benchmark pricing guidance (>90% accuracy).

chunks.title: ReshaFarms, ReshaSathi IoT Hardware & Farm Advisory
chunks.chunk: To assist upstream silkworm rearing before mandi arrival, ReshaMandi introduced ReshaFarms advisory and the ReshaSathi IoT device. ReshaSathi monitored shed temperature and relative humidity during delicate larval cycles, alerting farmers via SMS to microclimatic variations that could ruin cocoon harvest quality and crop yield.

chunks.title: ReshaYarns B2B Silk Yarn Marketplace (~₹40 Cr+ Monthly Volume)
chunks.chunk: ReshaYarns was a B2B marketplace connecting yarn reelers with textile manufacturers and master weavers. Deepak led catalog denier standardization, order workflows, and fulfillment tracking across spinning mills and weaving clusters, standardizing commercial yarn exchange at ~₹40 Cr+ average monthly volume across 17K+ stakeholders.

chunks.title: Cotton Marketplace: Extensible Multi-Commodity Platform Rails
chunks.chunk: Deepak architected the multi-commodity transaction schema, ginning floor allocation protocols, and multi-truck split dispatch workflows for ReshaMandi's cotton expansion. By parameterizing staple length, moisture, and trash percentage into a unified engine, the architecture proved commodity-agnostic and accelerated subsequent fiber expansions 2×.

chunks.source: Sportstech AI Coach Case Study: Thesis & Scope
chunks.title: Sportstech AI Coach: Product Thesis & PM Ownership
chunks.chunk: The AI Coach thesis was: 'Athletes don't need generic chatbot motivation; they need real-time, context-aware workout coaching grounded in physical performance data with uncompromising safety.' Deepak led product strategy, conversational flows, context data assembly (heart rate, historical loads, fatigue signals), athlete safety guardrails, and prompt architecture.

chunks.source: Sportstech AI Coach Case Study: Growth & Models
chunks.title: AI Coach Growth, Beta Validation & Multi-Model Architecture
chunks.chunk: The AI Coach followed a disciplined rollout: internal dogfooding with coaches, a 100-user phased beta, and production launch with a voice vs text A/B experiment. The feature scaled from an initial cohort of ~300 DAU to ~2,000 DAU in roughly 3 months through iterative improvements. It ran on a multi-model architecture using Gemini as the primary engine for multimodal reasoning with ChatGPT as reliable fallback.

chunks.source: Sportstech AI Coach Case Study: Safety
chunks.title: AI Coach Safety Governance & Medical Escalation Guardrails
chunks.chunk: Safety governance followed the principle: 'Safety Before Engagement; AI is not a physician.' The system enforced strict physiological load caps, fatigue thresholds, prohibited medical diagnostic statements, and routed suspected injuries to human medical professionals. Across the launch period, the product recorded zero safety incidents or medical escalations.

chunks.title: B2C Subscription Monetization: 0→1 Architecture
chunks.chunk: Deepak led the transition of a 100% free consumer sports app into a recurring subscription business with no prior playbook. He designed user onboarding, packaging tiers, paywall presentation triggers, European competitor pricing teardowns (Freeletics, Strava, Whoop), renewal-friction reduction, and checkout optimization from first principles.

chunks.title: Subscription Scale: 174K Users, 12.4K Paid, €659K FY25 Revenue
chunks.chunk: Under Deepak's subscription ownership, the platform grew to 174,180 freemium users and 12,401 paying subscribers, generating €659K in FY2025 subscription revenue. Key performance metrics included 81.9% YoY subscriber growth, 96.8% annual plan retention, and a 39.4% conversion rate (172/437 users) in the mature trial cohort through renewal-friction reduction.

chunks.title: Sportstech Platform Telemetry: 3,033 DAU, 27,001 MAU
chunks.chunk: Deepak owned product performance tracking across acquisition, engagement, and subscription funnels. Telemetry and cohort instrumentation tracked DAU, MAU, conversion, and churn to inform weekly prioritization. The overall consumer fitness platform scaled to 3,033 DAU and 27,001 MAU (an 11% DAU/MAU ratio).

chunks.source: Sportstech AI Localization Case Study: Workflow
chunks.title: AI-Assisted Video Localization: 200+ Videos in ~3 Weeks (~10× Faster)
chunks.chunk: Traditional video dubbing required 3–4 months using external voice studios. Deepak designed an AI-assisted localization pipeline that shipped 200+ workout coaching videos across Italian, French, and Spanish in roughly 3 weeks (~10× faster) using ElevenLabs and HeyGen voice synthesis with human-in-the-loop native speaker quality checks for safety-critical cues.

chunks.title: Cross-Border ODC Leadership & Pod Management
chunks.chunk: At Sportstech, Deepak operated in an Offshore Development Center (ODC) model, leading the India-based product and engineering pod while business, sales, and operations sat at company headquarters in Germany. He directly managed and mentored a 6-person cross-functional pod (3 Product Managers, Growth Specialist, Content Specialist), defining roadmaps, setting quarterly OKRs, and reporting KPIs to executive leadership.

chunks.title: Athletic Performance Score: Architecture & PRD Status
chunks.chunk: The Athletic Performance Score is an architectural specification and PRD designed by Deepak ('One Body. One Score. One Ecosystem.') unifying strength, cardio, and recovery metrics into a single 0–100 athletic readiness score across 5 surfaces (mobile, console, tablet, web, weekly digest). Status: It was fully architected and review-ready across engineering and sports science, but was NOT launched to production; there are no production metrics or adoption claims.

chunks.title: Jagr: Autonomous Context Reconstruction Engine for PMs
chunks.chunk: Jagr is Deepak's flagship AI system built around the problem: 'Knowing what changed while I was away.' When product managers step away from Slack, GitHub, Linear, and Jira, context fractures across hundreds of messages, PRs, and tickets. Jagr continuously ingests team signals and operates on a 5-step loop: CONNECT → WATCH → INVESTIGATE → DECIDE → BRIEF. It strips noise, separates evidence into Observed vs Inferred vs Unknown, detects scope drift, and synthesizes an executive morning delta briefing with action items requiring PM sign-off. Throughout, human PM approval boundaries are enforced.

chunks.source: AI Systems I Built — Product Jury
chunks.title: Product Jury: Decision System for Product Managers
chunks.chunk: Product Jury is an applied AI system designed by Deepak based on the thesis: 'Make a product call you can defend — and keep the defence.' It solves the problem of product decisions vanishing after meetings. The system turns product judgements into permanent, defensible decision records through an 11-step loop: Artifact → Evidence → Jury → Decision → Red Team → Record → Revisit. It convenes multi-perspective evidence-aware jury personas and subjects provisional verdicts to red-team challenge. Crucially, the human PM always decides; the system never issues instructions.

chunks.source: AI Systems I Built — Dīpa Architecture
chunks.title: Dīpa: In-Memory Vectorless RAG Portfolio Assistant
chunks.chunk: Dīpa is the AI assistant running directly on Deepak's portfolio website. It uses an in-memory vectorless RAG architecture: build-time dense vector generation using gemini-embedding-2-preview (512-dim), in-memory exact cosine similarity ranking on server startup (zero hosted vector database latency or cost), a strict 0.68 confidence threshold for honest abstention, and constrained synthesis via gemini-3.1-flash-lite strictly citing retrieved source chunks without external hallucinations.

chunks.title: Why RAG Over Fine-Tuning for Portfolio Knowledge
chunks.chunk: Parametric weights in fine-tuned models are lossy and stochastic. When asked for precise historical metrics (such as ReshaMandi's ₹20–25 Cr monthly escrow disbursement or VTU engineering credentials), fine-tuned models frequently hallucinate plausible-sounding errors. In contrast, RAG cleanly separates knowledge storage from reasoning, guaranteeing 100% factual fidelity, instant updates without re-training, and verifiable citation provenance.

chunks.title: Dīpa Grounding Contract & Difference Between Fact and Absence of Fact
chunks.chunk: Dīpa operates under strict epistemic rules: it only answers from verified portfolio and resume evidence. If a fact is supported, it cites the source. If asked about facts not in the portfolio or resume, it clearly states: 'I don't have that in Deepak's verified portfolio material' rather than guessing. It distinguishes between fact and absence of fact: for example, LionCircuits is recognized as his earliest listed role, but not assumed to be his first job ever unless specified. For unlisted timeframes (like May 2020 – Jun 2021), it assumes nothing.

chunks.title: Deepak's Operating Principles & Product Philosophy
chunks.chunk: Deepak operates on three core principles: 1) Ground-Level Truth Over Boardroom Theories — spend time directly where products are used (in warehouses, silk mandis, gym floors), 2) Systems Architecture Before Feature Decoration — eliminate operational bottlenecks and design deterministic workflows before adding UI polish, and 3) Epistemic Modesty & Truthful Fallbacks — ground claims strictly in verifiable metrics, maintain clear audit trails, and design transparent system fallbacks.

chunks.title: Cocoon Bidding System: Real-Time Bidding Mechanics
chunks.chunk: Deepak's cocoon bidding system replaced subjective buyer-seller bargaining with a digital auction mechanism. The workflow: farmers' cocoon crates were weighed on digital scales and assigned a QR lot tag (Scan); reelers placed sealed bids or competed in dynamic windows (Bid); prices updated on mobile and mandi displays (Watch); highest bidder won the lot (Win); and payment triggered immediately to the farmer via instant banking rails (Pay). Transaction value improved >35% over manual baseline.
